retest_notes: Browser cases are consolidated by name using the latest retest. Selector and async-wait harness errors were corrected and rerun.
Initial candidate lifecycle assertions depended on a prematurely aborted harness case; the complete UI recruitment-to-receipt journey passed independently.
Erasure preserves redacted document tombstones; the original zero-row assertion was corrected to check privacy-safe tombstones and denied old URLs.
Shared shortlists reject modification; viewed synthetic shortlist feedback was separately saved and read back.

Queue safety checks refused broader processing until the target QA IDs were identified. The eventual AI task blocked on missing credentials; an empty manual runner and authenticated callback were checked separately.
HTTP 200 with ok=false from provider verification is classified as blocked, not provider success.
No real email, recruiter notification, provider checkout or bank transfer was sent.
